name: Juventus 2014–19
scopeNote: Juventus under Allegri, first spell (appointed 2014-07-16; tenure end 2019-05-26 per Wikipedia; departure announced 2019-05-17). Style: pragmatic, adaptable 3-5-2 inherited from Conte, with 4-3-1-2/4-4-2/4-3-3 in 2014/15 and 4-2-3-1 from 2016/17, per Wikipedia; Allegri's 'corto muso' (result over spectacle) is the stated label. Verified: shape, game-management, squad-building, stated-view, plus a 5-3-2 defensive shape and short-passing build-up from a pre-match 2017 final preview (Khel Now) and Allegri's bench-rotation words (2016). Pressing, width, marking, possession, transitions remain gaps (Sportskeeda and Soccertutor unreadable). Dates of last match not verified.
openQuestions: The anchor is the club's signing policy as much as Allegri's choices: is Juventus 2014–19 an Experience anchor for who gets minutes, or for who gets bought?
The 'corto muso' quote is dated to the Spal-Juventus press conference (2019-04-13) only by a 2025 secondary page; the 2019 primary was not found.
